result.summary: The layout is generally clean and consistent, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows an apparent data/rendering defect: two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same illustration, ETA and delivery fee, and that illustration looks like a low-fidelity placeholder rather than a real dish photo. The carousel cards also omit rating/cuisine metadata shown elsewhere, and a couple of low-contrast text treatments are worth tightening. Edge-clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The first two cards in 'Fastest near you' are exact duplicates ('Green Bowl Poké', same image, '15–25 min', '€0.90 delivery'), which reads as a broken/duplicated data feed rather than two distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the carousel results by restaurant ID; if these are genuinely different locations, differentiate them with a branch/neighborhood label and distinct imagery.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail appears to be a flat placeholder-style illustration (a white plate with abstract red/green blobs) that does not match the rich photographic-style imagery used in 'Popular right now', making the row look unfinished or like failed image loads.
issues.suggestion: Use real, consistently styled dish photography for all restaurant thumbnails and provide a proper branded fallback image if an asset fails to load.

issues.description: 'Fastest near you' cards show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards show rating, review count, ETA and cuisine. The inconsistent metadata density makes the top row feel incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add at least rating and cuisine (or a short descriptor) to the fastest-delivery cards so both sections share a consistent information hierarchy.

issues.description: The search placeholder ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') and the secondary gray text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') are light gray on white and likely fall below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken placeholder and secondary text to at least #6B7280-equivalent contrast (≥4.5:1) against the white background.

issues.description: In the fastest-delivery cards the ETA pill overlaps the dish illustration and sits very close to the card's bottom-left corner, partially covering the plate and creating a cramped composition compared with the badge placement in the popular cards.
issues.suggestion: Position the ETA badge with consistent padding (e.g., 12px inset) over a scrim or below the image so it never obscures the main subject of the thumbnail.
